cohort: The study included 70 pregnant women, comprising 38 healthy controls and 32 women diagnosed with pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH).
finding: Leptin levels were significantly higher in women with PIH compared to healthy pregnant women and correlated positively with BMI, while sirtuin levels (1, 3, 6) were similar in both groups.
mod_finding: Highest leptin levels were observed in women with PIH who required a cesarean section, suggesting that high leptin levels might be helpful to predict the necessity for a caesarian section.
cross-section timing: Between the 20th and 40th week of gestation
